tokyo-kyoto.evidence:
Calm-water paddling: 47 lake(s) of 1 km2 or more (OpenStreetMap natural=water, lake or reservoir), for example 琵琶湖 (669 km2), 霞ヶ浦（西浦） (169 km2) plus 7 canoe or kayak rental points or clubs (OpenStreetMap, merged within 300 m) = 54, which gives 10 (0 is 0, 1 is 2, 2-3 is 3, 4-6 is 4, 7-10 is 6, 11-20 is 8, 21 or more is 10).
Sea kayaking: 1809 km of coastline inside the area (Natural Earth 10 m coast, which smooths bays and fjords, so long coasts are underestimated) gives 10; 4 kayak or canoe rental points within 3 km of the coast gives 4; average 7. Median daily maximum wave in the paddling months 0.47 m (Open-Meteo marine record, history from about 2021), no reduction.
Whitewater and multi-day: not researched, left blank.
Water temperature: cool (median sea surface temperature 15.1 C in the paddling months (Mar, Apr, May), Open-Meteo marine record).
Skill levels: never (derived: never-paddled where calm-water paddling is 3 or more or class I-II is run; a little where class I-II or III is run; experienced where class IV or V is run).
